source: Spec #161 section 3 (final, 2026-10-06: Systems & Economy under the Game Director's steer) and the #161 Systems absorber amendment; #162 section 4.6. The armoury lanes each get their own laneBias key, both 1 (GD decision on #310, ticket 322). A slice's numbers live beside it (feature-slices.md 1.1).

spendGuard.source: #161 section 3 Definitions and acceptance 6, the GD steer of 6 Oct as #212 restates it: tree nodes (Marks and combos included) and tree-unlocked store items are 10-30% of a planet's spend on P2-P20 and 10-25% from P21 on, endless included, on the median of the pacing seeds. A band holds from its planet until the next band's; planet 1 is not judged. Levers if a planet misses, in order: kMark 4 -> 3, items 15 -> 12 u, kCapability 12 -> 10, then (endless only) M = 6 from P41.

nodeShareWatch.source: #165 (Vertical Scaler, GD split): a diagnostic, never a gate; above it on P2-P20, pull kCapability / kCombo before #212.

incomeCap.source: #161 Systems amendment (Vertical Scaler review, 6 Oct), the GD split of #212 (#385) and the Systems ruling on #385 (6167240683, Scaler amendment 6167249318): each income item at its last Mark, all charges and 100% uptime, brings at most 15% of a full hold of the band's ore in a trip (the drill's minutes to fill the hold), after the trip cap, on P10, P20, P40 and P60, at the bot's arrival and departure levels, on the median of the pacing seeds; an item over 15% before the clamp must be held by the trip ledger in play. Basis points, one share for every planet: the check is economic only. Levers if an item misses, in order: income cooldown floor 0.7 -> 0.8, then the income duration cap 1.4 -> 1.25 (tech.markAbsorb.income).
